name: seed

name: por_share_reaching_profitability
derivation: share of rows with month_rev_passes_cost >= 0, which marks the first of three consecutive cash-positive months

name: por_share_reaching_profitability_pct
derivation: the same share expressed as a percentage

name: por_median_month_rev_passes_cost

name: por_mean_of_per_path_min
derivation: mean of the trough column, which is each path's own minimum

name: por_trough_understatement_ratio
derivation: min of cum_cash_mean divided by mean of the per-path trough

name: por_trough_understatement_pct
derivation: one minus that ratio, as a percentage: how much shallower the headline trough is

name: por_final_year_contrib_per_hh_month_mean

name: retained_months_exam_year_mean
derivation: every acquisition pinned into the examination-year segment; active households summed over months divided by acquisitions summed over months

name: retained_months_pre_exam_mean
derivation: every acquisition pinned into the pre-examination-year segment, same arithmetic

name: retained_months_alevel_mean
derivation: every acquisition pinned into the A-level segment, same arithmetic

name: year10_to_year11_retained_months_ratio
derivation: pre-examination-year retained months divided by examination-year retained months, as the code produces it

name: year10_to_year11_ratio_p10
derivation: the same ratio at the tenth percentile of each

name: year10_to_year11_ratio_p90
derivation: the same ratio at the ninetieth percentile of each

name: share_paths_year10_at_least_doubles
derivation: share of paths on which the pre-examination cohort retains at least twice as many months as the examination cohort

name: shock_longest_bad_run_mean
derivation: longest run of consecutive months with the demand multiplier below 0.80, reconstructed from shock_rho, shock_sd and the published innovations

name: shock_longest_bad_run_p90
derivation: the ninetieth percentile of that run length

name: shock_share_paths_bad_run_6plus
derivation: share of paths with at least six consecutive months of demand at or below 0.80

name: shock_share_paths_bad_run_12plus
derivation: share of paths with at least twelve consecutive such months

name: shock_rho_median
derivation: median of the shock_rho driver column

name: share_paths_content_exceeds_acquisition
derivation: share of paths on which total content cost exceeds total acquisition and verification spend

name: share_paths_content_is_largest_line
derivation: share of paths on which content is larger than both acquisition and people

name: share_paths_peak_funding_over_10m
derivation: share of paths whose peak funding requirement exceeds ten million dollars

name: share_paths_terminal_cash_positive
derivation: share of paths ending the horizon with cumulative cash above zero

name: final_year_contrib_per_hh_month_gross_mean
derivation: net revenue less inference, support, payment and hosting only: a gross margin, not a net one

name: final_year_contrib_per_hh_month_allin_mean
derivation: net cash per active household month with acquisition and verification added back, so net of engineering, content, overhead, compliance and payment fees

name: allin_minus_gross_contrib_per_hh_month
derivation: the all-in figure less the gross one: what the gross margin leaves out

name: blended_retained_months_mean
derivation: retained months weighted by the sampled segment mix

name: final_year_ltv_gross_mean
derivation: gross contribution per household month times blended retained months

name: final_year_effective_cac_mean
derivation: final twelve months of acquisition and verification spend divided by final twelve months of acquisitions

name: final_year_ltv_over_cac_mean
derivation: mean gross lifetime value divided by mean final-year effective cost per acquisition

name: share_paths_final_year_ltv_below_cac
derivation: share of paths on which gross lifetime value is below the final-year effective cost per acquisition

name: missing_night_rota_cost_per_year
derivation: three full-time posts at the median Bengaluru salary and overhead multiplier, with a thirty per cent night premium

name: missing_night_rota_cost_total
derivation: that annual cost from the UK go-to-market month to the end of the horizon

name: missing_night_rota_share_of_total_cost
derivation: the missing rota divided by the total modelled cost

name: por_total_cost_recomputed
derivation: sum over paths and months of every modelled cost line, averaged over paths

name: imanconover_worst_corr_error
derivation: largest absolute difference between target_rank_corr and achieved_rank_corr
